item.title: PGTI Players Championship: Shaurya Bhattacharya Sets The Pace In Round One
item.description: DP World PGTI Ranking: Shaurya Bhattacharya, a three-time winner on the PGTI Tour, set the pace in round one of the INR 1.5 crore PGTI Players Championship 2026 being played at the Tollygunge Club in Kolkata.

item.title: No Pressure On India Opener Abhishek Sharma After 2 Ducks, Says Coach
item.description: India opener Ashishek Sharma should not feel under pressure at the T20 World Cup after failing to score a run so far, because he has "a clear plan and clear mindset", a team coach said Tuesday. Defend

item.title: WPGT 2026: Tvesa, Ridhima Share Lead After Day 1 Of Fourth Leg In Pune
item.description: Poona Club Golf Course: Tvesa Malik produced three birdies in the closing four holes while Ridhima Dilawari had five birdies on her front nine as both went neck-and-neck in Round One of Leg-4 of the Women's Pro Golf Tour 2026 at the Poona Club Golf Course. Both carded 3-under 68 each to share the lead after Day one.

item.title: Alcaraz Beats Rinderknech In Doha Opener For 150th Hard-court Win
item.description: Lexus ATP Head2Head: In his first outing since becoming the youngest man to complete the Career Grand Slam at the Australian Open, Carlos Alcaraz battled past Arthur Rinderknech 6-4, 7-6 (5) in Qatar Open.

item.title: Delhi Open 2026: Sumit Nagal Reaches Second Round, Top Seed Dane Sweeny Sent Packing
item.description: David Jorda Sanchis: India’s top-ranked player Sumit Nagal advanced to the second round of the men’s singles event of the Delhi Open 2026, which suffered a major upset as top seed Dane Sweeny of Australia was knocked out in his opening-round match by Kazakhstan’s Beibit Zhukayev.

item.title: T20 WC: SA Elect To Bowl First Against UAE
item.description: United Arab Emirates: South Africa have brought in Jason Smith, Kwena Maphaka, Anrich Nortje and George Linde as captain Aiden Markram won the toss and elected to bowl against the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in their final Group D clash of the Men’s T20 World Cup at the Arun Jaitley Stadium on Wednesday.

item.title: Rio Open: Fonseca Earns First Win Of The Season, Berrettini Prevails In Opener
item.description: Tomas Barrios Vera: Local hero Joao Fonseca earned his first win of the season at the Rio Open with a 7-6(1), 6-1 win over countryman Thiago Monteiro in the opening round.

item.title: T20 WC: 'Proud Of Dutch Team, But My Loyalty Lies With India,' Says Ryan Ten Doeschate Ahead Of Netherlands Clash
item.description: T20 World Cup: India’s assistant coach and former Dutch player Ryan ten Doeschate said he is proud of his national team’s progress, but his loyalty lies with the defending champions India, who will face the Netherlands in their final group stage match of the T20 World Cup 2026 at the Narendra Modi Stadium on Wednesday.

item.title: FIH Pro League: Angad Bir Singh Excited For Comeback To Indian Team With Renewed Confidence
item.description: Hero Hockey India League: Indian men’s hockey forward Angad Bir Singh has been named in the 24-member Indian squad for the Hobart leg of the FIH Pro League 2025-26, marking his return to international action after nearly a year, as he didn’t play for the senior team since making his international debut against Ireland during the FIH Pro League 2024–25 season in Bhubaneswar.

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir Beat Bengal To Reach Maiden Ranji Trophy Final
item.description: Bengal Cricket Academy: Jammu and Kashmir have stormed into their first-ever Ranji Trophy final with a six-wicket win over Bengal on day four of their semi-final at the Bengal Cricket Academy ground on Wednesday.
